title: The Master and the Padawan
description: She had been Padawan to Anakin Skywalker for many years, looking up to this Jedi hero with the worshipful eyes of a younger sister. But following the galaxy-wide tragedy of Order 66, Ahsoka Tano realized that the person she admired most had been reborn as his ruthless, almost inhuman opposite, Sith Lord Darth Vader. While assisting Kanan Jarrus' Rebel cell during the Galactic Civil War, heavy-hearted Ahsoka would confront and battle her former mentor, all the while vowing never to "abandon" him again.
